_doc: Tighten-only baseline for scripts/test-spawn-ratchet.js: the number of UNCLASSIFIED
synchronous child-process call sites each covered file is allowed to carry.
A file with no row here has an implicit baseline of 0 — enforcement is default-on and
The ratchet fails only when a measured count EXCEEDS its row. Lowering a number and
committing it is always allowed and is the only maintenance path; raising one is not a fix.
Classify a site instead, with a spawn-class line comment naming one of: cli-contract,
concurrency, crash, environment — or convert it in-process.
Regenerate the measured numbers with: node scripts/test-spawn-ratchet.js --json
